units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:4">Mikv. X, 4</cite> <he>ש׳ של סנדל</he> ed. Dehr. (ed. <cite ref="U01597"><he>שניצן</he></cite>, read: <he>שְׁנָצִין</he>) laces of a sandal, contrad. to <cite ref="H00042"><he>חֶבֶט</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>שְׁנָצוֹת</he>, with suffix <he>שְׁנָצָיו</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:1">Kel. XXVI, 1</cite>, sq. <he>כיס של ש׳</he> a bag which is closed by means of laces.—[<he>שנץ</he> pr. n. pl., v. <cite ref="U01820"><he>שֶׁצֶת</he></cite>.]
